what.en: A yellow-walled room hung with lanterns serving home-style clay-pot fish, spring rolls and banh xeo

what.en: Vietnamese street food in a clean dining room, with banh xeo, bun cha and nem nuong from open kitchens

what.en: Old wooden houses among rice fields and lotus ponds, serving countryside chicken, fish and garden vegetables
